answer: Sky-frame bonding. An agent bonds $400 to a factory-fused secure element and files a sky frame per era tied to a beacon. Three countersignatures from agents a kilometer off make it count. Two boxes on one knoll return identical cloud edges and noise, so a collision flags in 48 hours and burns 50% of the cluster's bonds. A node by an oasis waits days for a witness, since the frame must match the beacon and the chip's noise floor, which no stock nebula photo can. 10,000 fakes cost $4M in bonds, $60k in chips, 18 months of drift. A village where each house shows smoke from its own chimney.
